digest.component_or_area: rebar review-code command with project prompts
propositions: The review-code command fails with 'unknown prompt code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries' when the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion is activated, despite the prompt asset existing in the repository.
Project prompts committed to the repository are not resolved from the applicable repository root during enabled code-review execution for both local and attested sources.
The known prompts list returned on failure contains only built-in prompts and does not include the project-scoped prompt file.
Missing or unresolvable project prompt assets should fail with a precise configuration error rather than an unknown prompt error.
